parsed.rationale: The current node_score has residual_compute_ratio weight -0.3, which already yields the incumbent objective. Since the incumbent is verifier-approved and no improvement is known, propose a testable mutation: set residual_compute_ratio weight to -0.3 (same as current) to confirm no change, or alternatively adjust to -0.2 to test if reducing the penalty on compute ratio lowers objective. However, to avoid repeating blocked or non-improving targets, we choose a small change: set weight to -0.2.
